name: Home Assistant
description: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first. Control all your devices from a single, unified interface.
author: Home Assistant
notes: Home Assistant runs in host network mode for device discovery
First start may take several minutes to initialize
Access the web interface at http://your-server:8123
Create your admin account on first login
USB devices (Zigbee/Z-Wave) need to be passed through to the container
For USB devices, add device mappings in docker-compose.yml
Consider using the supervised installation for add-ons support
